attachments.origin_landmark: inferior edge of internal oblique and the inguinal ligament
attachments.insertion_landmark: pubic tubercle, via loops over the spermatic cord

innervation.root_levels: L1-L2 (genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: A derivative of internal oblique carried down with the descending testis. The cremasteric reflex it mediates -- stroking the medial thigh (L1 sensory, ilioinguinal) elevates the testis -- is lost in testicular torsion, and is one of the few reflexes with sensory and motor limbs in different nerves.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
